description:
Delete the subprocess suites that re-prove command exit codes and parity now owned by the projection suite.

## Background

`crates/jit/tests/cli_issue/exit_code_tests.rs` and `invocation_exit_status_parity_tests.rs` re-prove bindings the exit-code projection suite owns, including the dependency-cycle exit code (`:69`). Their unique cases already have owners elsewhere. `crates/jit/tests/cli_issue/main.rs` declares both modules.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `exit_code_tests.rs` and `invocation_exit_status_parity_tests.rs` no longer exist, and `cli_issue/main.rs` declares neither.
- [hard] REQ-02: Every command-to-exit-code binding and human/machine parity case is proven by the projection suite.
- [hard] REQ-03: No live document or source comment cites either file.
title: Exit-code re-proof suites are deleted
